items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Mabel, her name is Mabel. Uh-huh. She was a Mitchell, who I married.

ctx.x: What was your wife's name? What's your wife's name?
Mabel, her name is Mabel. Uh-huh. She was a Mitchell, who I married. Uh-huh. Mabel Mitchell. Uh-huh.
You see, so it wasn't common to bring your wife on a job? No, no, I wouldn't.
